description: This file defines a React-like component for adding a new recipe in a Qwik-based frontend application. It handles form submission, navigation, and error display.

methods.name: component$
methods.description: Main component for the 'Add New Recipe' page, rendering the form and handling submission.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Asynchronous function called when the form is submitted, creates the recipe, then navigates to the recipe detail.
